Protocol.Input: Compressed bytes already in memory; reused caller-owned output buffers; no disk, PNG decoding, encryption or path lookup in timing.
Protocol.Zlib: System.IO.Compression.ZLibStream; Fastest and Optimal; construct/dispose one stream per compressed unit; ReadExactly plus EOF/trailer check.
Protocol.Lz4: K4os.Compression.LZ4 1.3.8; LZ4Level.L00_FAST; raw independent blocks; verify decoded byte count.
Protocol.Framing: Whole corpus or independent <=65536-byte blocks. Ratio includes Zlib wrapper/checksum; excludes package block tables for both codecs.
Protocol.Policies: always_decode: force codec even for incompressible blocks. auto_fallback: block stored raw when compressed length >= raw, and decoded via memory copy.
Protocol.Order: Seeded randomized case order every round; single logical CPU; calibrated iteration count per case; every round byte-for-byte verified.
